functions.note: Direction#getStepX/Y/Z read normal.getX/Y/Z instead of axis == X/Y/Z ? axisDirection.getStep() : 0; each Direction's normal is the Vec3i of exactly those steps (DOWN (0,-1,0) ... EAST (1,0,0)), so every facing gives the same triple, the one DIRECTIONS holds (piston.rs:18-25)

VoxelShape#bounds (added) is the min/max of the shape's boxes, the fold here; vanilla's moveCollidedEntities reads it only from 1.16 and returns first on an empty shape (None here, and push's box loop is then empty). Before 1.16 the same min/max comes from getMinMaxPiecesAABB, whose unit-cube seed push adds itself (piston.rs:341-345), and on 1.8 Block.getCollisionBox is one box. Both sides of 1.13.2 compute the same bounds

only legacy_moved_box calls it, whose callers are moving_block_collision_boxes' 1.9 - 1.10 branch (!at_least(1, 11, 0), piston.rs:173) and push_before_1_11 (push_in_turn, piston.rs:261): 1.11.2 never reaches it
only legacy_moved_box calls it, reached only on 1.9 - 1.10 (piston.rs:173, 261): neither 1.12.2 nor 1.13.2 runs it

getMovementDirection (added) is `extending ? direction : direction.getOpposite()`, the expression 1.12.2's moveCollidedEntities and 1.9.4's write inline (`this.extending ? this.direction : this.direction.getOpposite()`); same value on both sides
its callers are push (only on push_in_turn's 1.11+ branch, piston.rs:261-268) and carry (at_least(1, 15, 0), piston.rs:563): 1.10.2 never calls it

moveByPositionAndProgress became static with the position and block entity as arguments; the 1.17 caller passes the block entity's own position (tick's pos) and the same getExtendedProgress(progress) times the steps, so the corner is the same

the push rewrite is push_in_turn's: push_in_turn sends 1.8 to push_before_1_9 (!at_least(1, 9, 0), piston.rs:258) and 1.9 - 1.10 to push_before_1_11 (!at_least(1, 11, 0), piston.rs:261). Player#tick's changes (cloak, stats, border clamp, attack ticker) leave `noPhysics = isSpectator()`, which is what this function mirrors (piston.rs:252), as it was

the 1.11 push (per-box areas, PISTON move, pistonDeltas) is push_in_turn's 1.11+ branch (piston.rs:261-269), and the deltas this function hands on are only read by limit_piston_movement on that branch (move_by_piston, piston.rs:663); Player#tick's change is lastItemInMainHand EMPTY for null, not noPhysics
Player#tick drops a field reset when not a passenger; this function reads only noPhysics = isSpectator() from it, unchanged

moveCollidedEntities reads the pieces from getCollisionShape(level, pos).toAabbs() instead of appendCollisionBoxes at ZERO: the same local boxes of the moved state, which the engine takes as piston.shapes from its caller; getEntitiesIn(null, box) became getEntities(null, box), both NO_SPECTATORS; getMovementDirection is the old inline expression. Player#tick's changes (underwater, turtle helmet, rest stat) are not noPhysics

pistonDeltas gets its zeros from the field initializer instead of the constructor (1.13.2 Entity.java:326); Level#getEntities finds chunks with getChunk(x, z, false) instead of hasChunk: the player's own chunk is loaded on both sides, so the same player is found; Player#tick's changes (sleep) are not noPhysics
Player#tick's changes are getX/getZ, a crouch stat and lastItemInMainHand; noPhysics = isSpectator() is unchanged

the query box from shape.bounds() (no unit-cube seed) is push's at_least(1, 16, 0) branch (piston.rs:341-345); the motion packet to a ServerPlayer is no movement of the replayed player; Player#tick drops clearFire for invulnerable players, not noPhysics
a ServerPlayer under slime is skipped whole from 1.16.2: push's gate on bounces && is_player && !client_side && at_least(1, 16, 2) (piston.rs:321-328)

Player#tick adds the warden spawn tracker tick; noPhysics = isSpectator() unchanged
Player#tick moves the warden tracker and uses ItemStack.isSame; noPhysics = isSpectator() unchanged

the end drops the movedState != null guard; a moving block the engine is given always has its moved block (piston.shapes), so the guard never failed for it
